topic: Public worldwide research opportunities across independent scientific fields
review_type: human-guided synthesis of public research, NOT automatic AGI invention
source_date_policy: Differentiate original journal date, institutional announcement date, and third-party news syndication. News appearing today may refer to results published weeks/months earlier.

leads.headline: Room-temperature spin-orbit-coupled exciton-polariton supersolidity
leads.observed: Organic MeLPPP excitonic semiconductor and voltage-controllable liquid-crystal microcavity at room temperature produce reported condensation, spatial stripes and polarization order. No photonic computer demonstrated.
leads.known_limitations: University reports reactive semiconductor/liquid-crystal interface causing sample lifetime measured in hours; polaritons short-lived and device-scale robustness unproven.
leads.public_review_question: How is interface stability measured without losing optical coupling, dispersion, polarization and repeated-shot stripe/vortex observables?
leads.low_risk_first_evidence: Read full public experimental methods, verify baseline optical observables and lifetime definition, compare only published compatible material properties, specify required controls prior to proposing a new fabricated device.
leads.independent_falsifier: A candidate stabilizing condition that improves lifetime but removes the published polaritonic strong coupling/supersolid signature does not solve the device problem.

leads.headline: Spontaneous valency and lower-coordination superlattices from flexible charged nanoparticle ligands
leads.observed: Nature Materials authors report experiments and simulations in which deformable charged polymer ligands permit effective particle valency and superlattice structures beyond densely packed neighbors.
leads.known_limitations: Transfer to other nanoparticle chemistries and manufacturing-scale defects has not been independently demonstrated by Plenum; source access and supplementary data rights should be checked.
leads.public_review_question: Can already published coarse-grained ligand flexibility and electrostatic models predict relative coordination versus a rigid-ligand control without post-hoc parameter fitting?
leads.low_risk_first_evidence: Reproduce a published qualitative trend on existing licensed/released datasets using mature simulation software only if compatible parameters are disclosed; require baseline, uncertainty and independent heldout topology class.
leads.independent_falsifier: No reproducible change in coordination/distribution when ligand flexibility is varied under otherwise controlled published boundary conditions.

leads.headline: Automated on-orbit truss assembly with robotic gantry and mesh deployment
leads.science_publication_date: not a new peer-reviewed paper verified in this review
leads.observed: Caltech/DARPA report actual on-orbit assembly of a section of a modular truss by a gantry robot, not construction of a full proposed large spacecraft; the complete design remains unfinished.
leads.known_limitations: Complete mission-scale assembly, robust recovery from misaligned connections, mass/energy performance and generalized component geometries not independently established by source demonstration.
leads.public_review_question: What closed-loop checks are needed to detect and recover from a failed strut/joint connection without additional launches or destructive loads?
leads.low_risk_first_evidence: Use existing open licensed digital robotic workcell simulator where available; define part-pose error, placement success, cycle time, failure recovery and baseline deterministic sequence on unfamiliar geometries before any hardware.
leads.independent_falsifier: The recovery policy does not improve heldout placement success and cost versus pre-specified deterministic control while obeying load/position safety limits.

leads.headline: Digestion-resistant plant proteins and dietary fiber modulate microbiome metabolite sources
leads.science_publication_date: 2026 PNAS volume 123 issue 32 (not a November 9 first publication)
leads.observed: Ludwig/Princeton investigators report labeled dietary substrate/host protein contributions to gut phenol metabolites and production of certain compounds by mammalian metabolism independent of microbes.
leads.known_limitations: Animal and cellular studies do not establish dietary interventions' efficacy in people, and many metabolite interpretations are associative or context-dependent.
leads.public_review_question: Can published stable-isotope mass-balance and metabolic-pathway evidence separately identify host and microbial sources with negative tracer controls?
leads.low_risk_first_evidence: Analyze only licensed published aggregate isotope-tracing data; define reproducibility, missing-data and metabolite-assignment confidence; clinician or biosafety review before biological experiments.
leads.independent_falsifier: Independent traced material balance fails to distinguish host from microbial production reliably or does not reproduce paper's claimed directional result.

next_gate: For a selected lead, read permitted primary methods/data, define one original quantitative discriminating question with comparator and failure criterion, check established simulations and prior art, then conduct an independently reviewed model/bench test. Novel confidential design details should be kept in founder-private work, not this public repository.
caveats: A secondary headline is an alert, not an independent scientific replication.
No claims that Plenum has developed or patented the devices or treatments described.
This public research record is not a grant proposal or clinical/engineering protocol.
Rough prospective ideas do not demonstrate AGI, and coverage is not exhaustive.
